outcome: Use of continuous airway positive pressure
cohort: 1135 singleton pregnancies delivered by cesarean section before labor between 34(+0) and 38(+6) weeks of gestation from January 2010 to August 2011 at five Italian tertiary care hospitals.
finding: Neonatal complications in newborns delivered by cesarean section before labor decreased by half each week from 34 to 38 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: This study examined neonatal outcomes following cesarean section (CS) before labor and found that while complications decreased with each gestational week, respiratory problems persisted at early term gestation.
